scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:menu" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:account" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:gateway"
scripts.dev:menu: npm run import --prefix menu-service && npm run dev --prefix menu-service
scripts.dev:order: npm run import --prefix order-service && npm run dev --prefix order-service
scripts.dev:account: npm run import --prefix account-service && npm run dev --prefix account-service
scripts.start: npm-run-all --parallel start:menu start:order start:account start:frontend start:gateway
